# GlobalStreamHub VIP Full System Architecture, Hardware Installation & Service Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
GlobalStreamHub VIP (https://globalstreamhub.net) is an enterprise-grade 4K/UHD Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) broadcasting and Video-on-Demand (VOD) network designed specifically for British, European, and North American viewers. The service delivers ultra-low-latency, zero-buffering live sports and entertainment streams across every major consumer operating system.

## 2. Live Sports Broadcasting Specifications
- **English Premier League (EPL)**: Full broadcast coverage of all 380 matchday fixtures in genuine 4K UHD 60FPS. Includes full bypass of the UK Saturday 3:00 PM domestic blackout via international feed clustering (NBC Peacock, Optus Sport, Astro SuperSport, DAZN Canada, beIN Sports MENA).
- **Sky Sports UK**: All 12 channels in 4K UHD 50/60FPS with 5.1 Dolby audio.
  - Sky Sports Main Event 4K
  - Sky Sports Premier League 4K
  - Sky Sports Football HD/4K
  - Sky Sports F1 (Formula 1 live telemetry & 4K UHD race stream)
  - Sky Sports Cricket, Golf, Action, Arena, Racing, Mix, News, Tennis
- **TNT Sports UK**:
  - TNT Sports Ultimate 4K with HDR & Dolby Atmos
  - TNT Sports 1, 2, 3, 4 HD/4K (UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, Serie A, Gallagher Premiership, MotoGP)
- **North American Sports**:
  - NFL Sunday Ticket & NFL RedZone (all out-of-market games, zero local blackout)
  - NBA League Pass (all 30 teams home and away feeds in 60FPS)
  - NHL Center Ice & regional blackout bypass feeds
  - MLB Extra Innings
  - TSN 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in 4K UHD
  - Sportsnet Ontario, East, West, Pacific, Sportsnet ONE & 360
  - Peacock TV Premium 4K
  - ESPN+ Exclusive Match Streams (Bundesliga, FA Cup, Carabao Cup)
- **Combat & Pay-Per-View (PPV)**:
  - UFC Fight Nights & UFC Numbered PPV Main Cards
  - Matchroom Boxing, Queensberry Promotions, DAZN Boxing, Riyadh Season PPV
  - WWE Network Premium Live Events (WrestleMania, Royal Rumble, SummerSlam)
  - AEW All Elite Wrestling PPVs

## 3. Server Infrastructure & Anti-Freeze v9.8 Architecture
- **Distributed Edge CDN**: Dedicated nodes deployed across Equinix LD4 (Slough) and LD8 (Docklands, London), Equinix FR2 (Frankfurt), Equinix AM4 (Amsterdam), Equinix NY4 (New York), and Equinix TR2 (Toronto).
- **High-Capacity Bandwidth**: Dual 100Gbps Tier-1 network backbones (Lumen, Telia/Arelion, Cogent) ensuring 99.99% uptime during peak matchday viewership.
- **Adaptive Bitrate & Load Balancing**: Intelligent round-robin traffic routing that switches edge nodes within 35ms in the event of local ISP packet loss or regional throttling.

## 4. Hardware Installation & Downloader Shortcodes
### Amazon Fire TV (FireStick 4K / Max / Cube):
1. Install the official "Downloader" app from the Amazon Appstore.
2. Enable "Developer Options" -> "Install Unknown Apps" -> Allow Downloader.
3. Enter one of the verified official codes:
   - **GlobalStreamHub VIP 4K Custom Player**: `842013` (Official App with integrated 4K sports & automated EPG)
   - **TiviMate IPTV Player Pro**: `289018` / `272483` (Direct URL: `https://tivimate.com/apk`)
   - **iMPlayer TV IPTV**: `82375` (Direct URL: `https://implayer.tv/d`)
   - **IPTV Smarters Pro**: `914207` / `80198` (Direct URL: `https://www.iptvsmarters.com/smarters.apk`)
   - **XCIPTV Player Pro**: `762019` / `537992` (Direct URL: `https://xciptv.com`)
   - **IBO Player Pro 4K**: `541890` / `834339` (Direct URL: `https://iboplayer.pro`)
4. Open the installed application and sign in via Xtream Codes API (Server URL, Username, Password) provided in your activation email.

### Apple TV 4K & Apple iOS (iPhone, iPad, Mac M-Series):
1. Download **iMPlayer IPTV**, **IPTVX**, or **Smarters Player Lite** from the official Apple App Store.
2. Select "Xtream Codes API" login.
3. Enjoy Quad-view multi-screen, native AVPlayer/Metal hardware acceleration, and iCloud playlist synchronization.

### Smart TVs (Samsung Tizen & LG webOS):
1. Search for **IBO Player**, **Smart One IPTV**, or **Nanomid Player** in the Samsung Apps or LG Content Store.
2. Enter the device MAC Address and Device Key on the player's web portal to upload your M3U playlist.

### Dedicated Set-Top Boxes (Formuler & MAG):
- **Formuler**: Open MyTVOnline 2/3, create a new portal using Xtream Codes API or Portal URL.
- **MAG 254/322/424/524**: Provide your 00:1A:79:XX:XX:XX MAC address during checkout for Stalker Portal authorization.
